popupFocused.message: Focus popup window when refreshing it

remoteDataConsentRequired.message: Remote spam analysis is disabled. Open the add-on settings and enable Privacy & Data Processing consent before sending email data to the server.

remoteDataConsentLabel.message: I agree that this add-on may send selected email data to a remote server for spam analysis.

privacyCurrentApiUrlEmpty.message: No remote API URL is configured for the selected backend.

privacyUseNotice.message: The selected data is used only for spam/ham analysis of the message and for creating Antispam rules requested by the user.

privacyNoConsentNotice.message: The checkbox is off by default. When it is off, the add-on does not send email data to a remote server and shows a local error instead of calling the API.

privacySentDataSender.message: Sender email address and derived sender domains/subdomains.

privacySentDataRecipients.message: Recipient email addresses and derived recipient domains/subdomains.

privacySentDataReplyTo.message: Reply-To email addresses and derived Reply-To domains/subdomains.

privacySentDataDomains.message: Domain and subdomain values selected for Antispam checks or rules.

privacySentDataReceivedIps.message: IP addresses extracted from the message Received headers.

privacySentDataRules.message: Rule type and rule pattern when the user creates an Antispam rule.

privacySentDataAuth.message: Configured API token or legacy webservice token needed for API communication.

privacySentDataMetadata.message: Standard HTTP request metadata, such as request time, IP address, user agent and the configured backend URL, may be visible to the remote server.

privacyPolicyText1.message: This Thunderbird add-on reads message metadata locally in Thunderbird and sends it only to the configured Antispam API or legacy webservice after the user enables the consent checkbox.

privacyPolicyText2.message: The add-on stores settings locally in Thunderbird. Remote storage and retention depend on the configured Antispam server; the add-on does not share data with other third parties.

privacyPolicyText3.message: The add-on does not notify ordinary web pages that it is installed. It requests host permission only for the configured backend origin used for API communication.

privacyPolicyFile.message: The full add-on-specific Privacy Policy is included in this repository and package as privacy-policy.txt.
